# paperverse

> A static, in-browser 3D map of research papers: abstracts are embedded with TF-IDF,
> laid out with UMAP, and searched with SQLite FTS5 — no server. Pick a paper to see its
> nearest neighbours; switch between the Demo and Real (curated AI-agent arXiv feed) datasets.

## App

- [paperverse](https://qte77.github.io/paperverse/): the live 3D paper cloud

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/qte77/paperverse): code, README and docs
- [Issues](https://github.com/qte77/paperverse/issues): bug reports and feature requests
